title: TrainingPeaks Workout Weekly Workout Time Trend
dataSources: TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), Garmin multisport activities (`garmin:multisport`), TriDot plans (`tridot:plan`), brick workouts (`brick:workout`), and transition logs (`transition:log`).
app: TrainingPeaks structured workouts, Garmin multisport FIT exports, TriDot training plans, brick workout logs, and transition timing notes ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trainingpeaks:workout workout_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(workout_minutes) as avg_duration, max(workout_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst workout time for TrainingPeaks workout events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture workout_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average workout time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether TrainingPeaks workout tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
